Both JSON commands use these paths, so git calls still grow with ordinary stories and fixes.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. The call-count test adds fixes that are already on the landed branch and open stories whose local and remote tips match. Those fixtures skip the per-fix `review_ref` calls and the per-story `merge-base` call. The test therefore passes while git calls grow in both normal cases, leaving the Done-when behavior without effective command-level proof.
